hero.description: Empowering school students and future pioneers through gamified code arenas, verified algorithmic pathways, interactive problem visualizers, and real-time Grandmaster mentorship.

learningJourney.title: Learning Journey
learningJourney.description: A guided journey from programming fundamentals to competitive problem-solving.

foundation.title: 01 — Foundation
foundation.description: Learn the fundamentals of programming, logical thinking, and basic problem-solving.

algorithms.title: 02 — Algorithms
algorithms.description: Explore data structures, algorithms, and efficient problem-solving techniques.

practice.title: 03 — Practice
practice.description: Solve problems, practice under time limits, and learn from virtual contests.
practice.milestone: Apply your skills under time pressure.

contestReady.title: 04 — Contest Ready
contestReady.description: Prepare for suitable competitions and develop stronger contest strategies.
contestReady.milestone: Be ready to take on your next contest.

studentVoices.title: Our Students’ Voices
studentVoices.description: Read what young competitors, their parents, and tournament awardees say about the Ps-Prism journey.

liam.name: Liam
liam.quote: The live visualizer made recursion and trees finally click for me! I used to get stuck on edge cases, but now I can clearly trace every single branch.

sarah.name: Sarah
sarah.quote: My daughter went from absolute beginner to placing in her first state coding contest in under 6 months. The community support here is extraordinary.

ethan.name: Ethan
ethan.quote: The weekend speed-coding battles are intense and teach real problem-solving under pressure. My time complexity instincts got so much sharper!

priya.name: Priya
priya.quote: Having mentors break down solutions step-by-step changed how I approach math and code. I never feel embarrassed asking why an approach didn’t work.

footer.description: A dedicated youth coding initiative fostering computational intuition, mathematical proofs, and collaborative competitive coding for primary, middle, and high school learners.
